newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR FIRMER BUT FUNDS COULD LIQUIDATE.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR FIRMER BUT FUNDS COULD LIQUIDATE.

text.p: White sugar futures hovered around nearby $323 support basis October as the market prepared for fund players to consider liquidating long positions built up in the past two weeks.
Traders said the three or four funds which were still long in October whites were likely to sell if market closes were to continue at current levels,
Since the fund-led buying spree drove October to a new life-high of $331 at the end of July, the spot month has been drifting lower in generally light daily volumes.
"I think quite a lot of people were hoping more stops were going to be taken out," said one trader.
But although October support looked reasonably solid, prices could still edge back to $321 or $320, he added.
Trade house crosses and commission house activity on both sides of the market accounted for most of the thin turnover, which totalled 339 lots by 1050 GMT.
On the spreads, October/March commanded trading interest at around $1.50, offered at $2.00, but traders said the general feeling was that it was overvalued.
October stood up 30 cents at $323.50 after briefly dipping to $322.50. December was up 10 cents at $320.30 while other positions were flat to a touch firmer.
Traders said the October/October differential against New York was likely to attract trade buying as it was considered cheap at around $65.
In fundamental news, Syria tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws for September 9. Shipment is to be made in October.
Another tender for 13,000 tonnes of whites for shipment between September 20 and October 20 is still valid.
Brazilian sugar stocks in the centre-south growing region were around 1.09 million tonnes on July 16, around 496,000 tonnes less than at the same stage last year.
Since the start of the region's harvest, around 1.68 million tonnes have been delivered to the domestic market and 1.14 million tonnes to the international market.
Only the two nearby contracts were traded on the Paris white sugar market in an overall volume of 143 lots. October was down 40 cents at $322.80 and December down 20 cents at $320.00.
